value.part1:
Let us who mystically, mystically represent the Cherubim, the Cherubim.

And who sing the Thrice-holy Hymn.

And who sing the thrice-Holy hymn to the life-creating, life-creating Trinity.

Now lay aside all cares, now lay aside all cares.
Lay aside all earthly cares.
All earthly cares.

(Repeat until Great Entrance procession.)
value.part2:
That we may receive the King of all, Who comes invisibly, invisibly upborne by the angelic hosts.
By the angelic hosts.

value.part1: We, the Cherubim mystically representing, and to the Life-giving Trinity the thrice-holy hymn chanting, let us now lay aside all earthly cares.
value.part2: That we may receive the King of all, Who cometh invisibly upborne by the angelic hosts.
